scenes.headline: Session done. Notes still waiting.
scenes.sub: The charting that follows every session.
scenes.vo: You finished the last session. Now the notes are waiting.

scenes.headline: Dictate it. Get a SOAP draft.
scenes.sub: Speak or paste the session; review a structured draft.
scenes.vo: Dictate or paste your session, and SOAP Autopilot drafts a complete SOAP note.

scenes.headline: Audio stays on your device.
scenes.sub: Voice dictation runs locally on your own machine.
scenes.vo: Voice dictation runs locally, so the audio never leaves your device.

scenes.headline: Sign it. Lock it.
scenes.sub: Corrections become amendments, never silent edits.
scenes.vo: Signed notes lock with a tamper-evident hash. Corrections become amendments.

scenes.headline: Self-serve cancel and waitlist.
scenes.sub: Clients manage visits within your policy.
scenes.vo: On Professional, clients cancel within your policy and join a waitlist themselves.
